async def submit(self, model_name: str, req: GenerateRequest) -> GenerateResponse:
    if len(self._queues[model_name]) >= self.max_queue_size:
        raise BufferError("Inference queue is full")
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    fut = loop.create_future()
    self._queues[model_name].append((req, fut))
    if len(self._queues[model_name]) >= self.max_batch_size:
        asyncio.create_task(self._flush(model_name))
